item.title: Meet Doddy, an AI companion that wants to do it all for you
item.description: Doddy is an AI companion for your iPhone with a big goal. One day it should help with anything you need, and it will always ask before it acts. Here's what it does today, what it can't do yet, how we keep it safe, and answers to the questions people ask most.
